# CLI Proxy API

> Enterprise-grade Go 1.26+ AI proxy gateway providing unified OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Codex, Gemini, Tencent WorkBuddy, and OpenCode API compatibility with multi-strategy quota scheduling, persistent session affinity, and stream resilience.

## Core Capabilities
- **Unified Protocol Translation**: Bidirectional mapping across OpenAI (`/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/responses`, `/v1/models`), Anthropic (`/v1/messages`), Google Gemini, and Codex WebSocket relays.
- **Multi-Strategy Load Balancing (`routing.strategy`)**: `round-robin`, `weighted-round-robin`, `fill-first`, `smart` (expiry-first), and `pace` (burn-rate pacing) with an HTTP 429 cooldown sink pool.
- **Persistent Session Affinity**: Persists conversation-to-credential bindings (`session_affinity.json`) across restarts to maximize prompt-cache hits.
- **Native Domestic Agent Suites**:
  - **Tencent WorkBuddy / CodeBuddy**: Dual-realm routing (`workbuddy/` & `workbuddy-cn/`), `WB_CN_CHAT_UPSTREAM` overseas TLS bypass, 5.8.4 conversation headers, `stream: true` SSE aggregation, live credit multipliers, CST `CheckinEngine`, and 500-credit outage compensation.
  - **OpenCode Zen**: `/inference/v1` normalization, `oc_sk_...` key self-healing, `bash`/`read` schema injection with stub filtering, and zero-config 1M free models.
- **Stream & Privacy Resilience**: 15s SSE `: keep-alive` heartbeats against HTTP 524/504 timeouts, `LoopGuard` breaker, selective Gzip compression, and HMAC-SHA256 zero-knowledge redaction (`redact`).

## Quick Start
```bash
go build -o cli-proxy-api ./cmd/server
./cli-proxy-api --config ./config.yaml --no-browser
# CLI OAuth Logins: --claude-login, --codex-login, --workbuddy-login
```
